description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseTestClusterFixture' for setting up and managing Orleans test clusters in integration tests, including configuration, initialization, and disposal logic.

classes.name: BaseTestClusterFixture
classes.description: An abstract base class for Orleans test cluster fixtures providing setup, configuration, and cleanup methods for testing environments.

methods.name: EnsurePreconditionsMet
methods.description: Checks if preconditions for running the test are met, throwing captured exception if not.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Virtual method to be overridden for specifying precondition checks before cluster setup.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Virtual method to allow configuration of the TestClusterBuilder before cluster deployment.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up and deploys the Orleans test cluster asynchronously, initializes logger and other properties.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the test cluster, stopping silos and releasing resources.

methods.name: GetClientServiceId
methods.description: Retrieves the ServiceId from the Orleans cluster client configuration.
